3259-4373-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4373-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3169-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3169-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3179-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3179-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-4247-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-4247-5434.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7825.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Bifur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
413-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

876-6875-7070.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
876-6875-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Raucous Audience.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Raucous Audience.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Raucous Audience.
Activate Raucous Audience by tapping it, adding {G}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Raucous Audience.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Raucous Audience.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Raucous Audience from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

423-1313-1362-1437.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1313-1362-1437.description:
Cast Arboreal Grazer by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Arboreal Grazer spell three times.
Resolve the first Arboreal Grazer copy.
The Arboreal Grazer token enters the battlefield, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering Evolution Sage.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

3358-4460-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6730-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-6730-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4359-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

5086-5183-5231-6441-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6441-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-4871-5795-6000-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sapphire Medallion.
Repeat.

3532-5078-5231--73.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
If the persist or undying creature does not have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature, adding {R}
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing the +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter from the persist or undying creature.
Repeat.

3951-4452-5686-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-4452-5686-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2793-3743-4067-4365-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4067-4365-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1170-3540-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{B}{B}.
1170-3540-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{B}{B}.
Cast Mourning by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Mourning spell.
Activate Mourning by paying {1}{B}{B}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1365-3263-4853-5226--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3263-4853-5226--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Lithatog's first ability by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3933-4029-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3933-4029-4929-5479.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

238-1806-2034-3008.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional nontoken creatures.
238-1806-2034-3008.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing three nontoken creatures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge by paying {3}.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Eternal Scourge.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing Eternal Scourge to become a copy of Gerrard.
Put Eternal Scourge into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Eternal Scourge dies as a copy of Gerrard, it triggers, exiling itself and returning all other artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1391-1636-3977.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional green or red creature.
1391-1636-3977.description:
Cast Horned Kavu by tapping Fallaji Wayfarer and a green or red creature.
Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Horned Kavu trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2962-4447.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Pirate Ship.
A player controls no Islands.
2962-4447.description:
If needed, give control of Pirate Ship to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Pirate Ship's controller controls no Islands, Pirate Ship triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Pirate Ship cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Pirate Ship triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

3030-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
3030-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Skeleton Shard by paying {B} or {3} and tapping it, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.
